## Summary

Describe the user-visible behavior and why this change is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] I ran the relevant tests and static checks.
- [ ] I added or updated behavior-level tests.
- [ ] If sorting rules changed, I added idempotence, permutation, and fixture coverage.
- [ ] If dependencies, packaging, or containers changed, I ran the relevant artifact smoke check.

## Compatibility, security, and documentation

- [ ] I considered API/CLI, Python-version, and SPDX-version compatibility.
- [ ] I considered security and least-privilege implications.
- [ ] I updated README, governance/release plans, or other documentation where needed.

The PR title must be a Conventional Commit and will become the squash-merge
commit subject (for example, `fix(cli): retain file mode`).
